items.title: Alleged killer of 5yo girl moved to Darwin after violent clashes outside hospital
items.description: Kumanjayi Little Baby's alleged killer Jefferson Lewis, 47, has been flown to Darwin after violent clashes outside the Alice Springs hospital he had been in.

items.title: Bondi royal commission interim report careful but ultimately damning
items.description: The message beneath the restrained language of the report investigating the Bondi terror attack is that by Hanukkah 2025, Australia had grown dangerously complacent about terrorism – and about the safety of the Jewish community.

items.title: Melbourne and Sydney record largest house price falls across the country
items.description: Momentum in the housing market has slowed, with every capital city recording a slower pace of growth in April.

items.title: 'Gentle parenting' under fire from this alternative school's supporters
items.description: For 50 years, this alternative school sold parents a vision of progressive education. But some who have passed through its doors say a 'cult-like' culture enabled decades of unchecked physical abuse.

items.title: Poliovirus detected in Perth wastewater
items.description: Poliovirus has been detected in a sample taken from a wastewater in Perth, the Health Department reveals.

items.title: Ukrainian drones hit oil refineries in Russia, 1,500km from front line
items.description: Ukraine says its drones have struck an oil refinery deep inside Russia, marking the latest in a series of attacks on oil facilities behind the front lines as Kyiv seeks to curb Moscow’s energy revenues used to fund the war.

items.title: Live: Commanders to brief Trump on fresh military options for Iran war
items.description: Iran says it will respond with "long and painful strikes" on US positions if Washington renews attacks, and also reasserted its control over the Strait of Hormuz. Follow live.

items.title: The battery rebate became a victim of its success. Here's what is changing
items.description: In less than nine months, more than a quarter of a million batteries were installed in Australian households. Here's how the battery rebate is changing and why.

items.title: LIV Golf is falling apart on a flawed premise and a broken promise
items.description: While Adelaide showed just how good LIV Golf could be, the flawed premise of the breakaway tournament always spelled trouble.

items.title: Hard-won legacy of Australia's longest strike in jeopardy
items.description: It's been 80 years since Aboriginal workers in the Pilbara up-ended a slave-like labour system. The descendants of those involved fear its legacy is being forgotten.

items.title: Live: Taylor says government is in 'denial' about situation in NT town camps
items.description: Opposition leader Angus Taylor says the federal government is in "denial" about the situation in town camps following the death of Kumanjayi Little Baby. Follow live.

items.title: Live: Wall Street surges despite Meta and Microsoft dives, ASX rebounds and ANZ profit jumps
items.description: Wall Street rises despite Meta crashing on AI spending fears, and the ASX rebounds after seven losing sessions. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

items.title: This one key interest rate exposes Australia's 'inflation problem'
items.description: The 10-Year Treasury bond, which the Commonwealth issues to raise money, pushes past 5 per cent, raising the cost of paying off debt and suggesting inflation is not under control.

items.title: NT ambulance service on brink of collapse, CEO says
items.description: A woman was left to suffer a seizure for two hours due to ambulance services being overwhelmed by call-outs earlier this month. The organisation's new chief executive has said unless more resources are funded to ease demand, the service could collapse.

items.title: Weekly news quiz: A Trump shooting scare, a burger blue and a rescued roo
items.description: It's time to sit back after a big week in news and test how much you remember.

items.title: Is the new Foo Fighters the best album of April?
items.description: Come for Dave Grohl and co's latest. Stay for club-facing collabs, lush disco, homegrown releases and a pair of Québécois aliens making left-field instrumental jams.

items.title: How a terrible gig for personal trainers led Guy Montgomery to his big break
items.description: Guy Montgomery is back with the third season of his inimitable Spelling Bee, with brand-new sidekick Sam Campbell. We turn the tables on the Kiwi comic to ask him the tough questions.

items.title: 'Too hard to prove': Concerns raised after one year of coercive control laws in Queensland
items.description: When Stephanie* called the police to report coercive control, she says she was told it was "too hard too prove" and it was "unlikely a case would ever succeed".

items.title: Tense moment at FIFA Congress as delegate refuses 'absurd' handshake request
items.description: FIFA boss Gianni Infantino is criticised as he attempts to encourage Israeli and Palestinian delegates to shake hands.

items.title: Stuart tells Bellamy to put himself first after shock neurological diagnosis
items.description: Raiders coach Ricky Stuart says Craig Bellamy needs to start putting himself first after the Storm revealed the coaching legend had been diagnosed with a neurological condition.

items.title: No 'legal barrier' blocking ISIS-linked families returning to Australia, law expert says
items.description: A week since a group of 13 Australian women and children with ties to former Islamic State fighters left a Syrian refugee camp for Australia, they remain in the capital Damascus in a state of limbo.

items.title: 'Neglected' seat of Farrer is turning against major parties
items.description: A fascinating four-cornered contest is brewing as voters in the southern NSW seat of Farrer head to the ballot box for the second time in 12 months.

items.title: Is a supermarket pricing shake-up on the cards?
items.description: As the Woolies federal court case wraps up and the Coles matter awaits judgment, here's what we've learned so far from the high-stakes cases.

items.title: Migrant crackdown still on ice as vote restores Homeland Security funding
items.description: "It is about damn time," said one Democrat as US politicians voted to end the funding freeze for most of the department's agencies after Mr Trump's deadly immigration operations in Minneapolis.

items.title: Sea creatures, strange finds and physical feats feature in WA photo wrap
items.description: From dawn services to record-breaking swims, here are our top photo picks for Western Australia in April.
